steps.say: Look at Black's king. Its own pawns block every step forward. If a rook reaches the back row, it's over.

task.hint: Your rook can go all the way up the e-file.
task.success: Back-rank mate! The pawns that protected the king became its prison.

steps.say: Here's a trick with two rooks on the same file. Black's rook guards the back row, but one guard can't stop two attackers.

task.hint: Take their rook with check. Whatever takes back, your other rook is waiting.
task.success: Two rooks, one file, checkmate. That's called doubling your rooks.

steps.say: The cure is simple: give your king some air. With a pawn on h6, the king just steps out to h7.
So guard your own back row, and look for theirs. A king with no air is a king in danger.
